_meta.format: Per-product test: how to identify the product, then which creds to try, then what 'success' looks like.

fields.name: human-readable product
fields.fingerprint_path: URL path that confirms product identity (for HTTP)
fields.fingerprint_regex: regex pattern in response body or headers
fields.success_re: regex pattern in response that indicates auth success
fields.success_code: HTTP code that indicates success (used if success_re absent)
fields.post: optional — POST data instead of basic auth
fields.next_step: what to do after finding default creds
